item.title: Man charged with attempted murder, after punching, choking Boulder officer, police say
item.description: Justin Lyle Radley-Sharpe, 36, faces multiple charges, including two counts of attempted first-degree murder, after police say he punched and choked a Boulder police officer.

item.title: Venezuela approves amnesty bill that could see release of hundreds detained for political reasons
item.description: Acting President Delcy Rodríguez is expected to sign the measure.

item.title: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson expanded to include South Carolina and Washington, DC
item.description: Jackson will lie in repose at the Chicago headquarters of his Rainbow PUSH Coalition.

item.title: NASA boss blasts Boeing and space agency managers for Starliner’s botched astronaut flight
item.description: Administrator Jared Isaacman said poor leadership and decision-making at Boeing led to Starliner's troubles.

item.title: Judge orders takeover of health care operations in Arizona prisons after years of poor care
item.description: The judge found Arizona violated prisoners’ rights by providing inadequate care.

item.title: Prosecutors stand by former Black Panther’s conviction but accuse judge of misconduct when he prosecuted the case
item.description: Al-Amin died in prison in November.

item.title: Lyons’ Gantzer, Holy Family’s Moore & Johnston ‘overcome and adapt’ at state wrestling tournament
item.description: Holy Family had a total of three wrestlers advance to the semifinals. Along with Moore, Breezy Johnston[cq comment="" ] (4A girls 125 pounds) and Graci Baker[cq comment="" ] (4A-G 155s) will wrestle Friday night with a spot in Saturday's finals on the line. Lyons' Rowan Gantzer will be in the 2A 106-pound consolations.

item.title: Water availability takes top priority for Northern Colorado farmers
item.description: Colorado’s dry winter — despite the snow falling Tuesday in the high mountains — was on the minds of farmers and agricultural professionals at BizWest’s CEO Roundtable of ag-industry professionals held Tuesday at the Better Business Bureau office in west Windsor.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His family says he spent his final days with loved ones.

item.title: Legacy’s Matthew Clifton, Mead’s Eric Hansen lead 4A/5A state wrestling semifinalists
item.description: From the moment that Legacy's Matthew Clifton won his third-place match at the Class 5A state wrestling tournament last season, he knew he would never be satisfied unless he was on top.
